footnote_text: The Reporting Person is voluntarily reporting the acquisition of shares of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock pursuant to the Rivian Automotive, Inc. 2021 Employee Stock Purchase Plan (the "ESPP") for the purchase period of May 21, 2026 through November 20, 2026 (the "Offering Period"). The acquisition of those 639 shares of Class A Common Stock was also exempt pursuant to Rule 16b-3(c). || In accordance with the ESPP, these shares were purchased at a price that represented 85% of the closing price of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock on November 20, 2026. || The Offering Period ended on November 20, 2026, and the shares were acquired on the last business day of the Offering Period.
